channel.title: FSD by the numbers: changes
channel.description: Updates and corrections to Supercharged Daily's FSD by the numbers page.

item.title: Update, 25 Nov 2026
item.description: Teslascope said at 4:53 p.m. ET on 24 Nov that FSD v15.0.1 (2026.38.6.11) is reaching some older HW4 Model Ys without a front bumper camera. Teslascope described this as specific vehicles being onboarded, not a new wave. The Teslascope build counts on this page still stop at 11 Nov and do not include v15; they are re-pinned by hand. A Commission spokesperson also told Reuters the EU TCMV meeting on Tesla Assisted Driving has been postponed to 15 Dec 2026; a vote is not guaranteed.

item.title: Update, 24 Nov 2026
item.description: Dispatch: Tesla's official FSD v15 first-wave post, the release notes and the three different 25x wordings, with a link to the official Tesla post.

item.title: Update, 22 Nov 2026
item.description: FSD v15 has started rolling out. Tesla said on X on 21 Nov that FSD v15 is now starting to roll out; the official post did not say which vehicles get it first. Tesla's listed changes include a shared vision encoder, a driving visualisation called Reality View, learned navigation, parking suggestions and detection of signs, animals, debris and potholes. Tesla says the encoder improves the critical intervention rate by 25x, with no baseline or data published. See our 24 Nov Dispatch piece for the official posts, the release notes and what independent trackers have reported. The Teslascope build counts on this page stop at 11 Nov and do not include v15; they are re-pinned by hand.

item.title: Update, 20 Nov 2026
item.description: Italy's Ministry of Transport granted a provisional approval (omologazione provvisoria) of Tesla Assisted Driving on 20 Nov 2026, announced by minister Matteo Salvini after a technical feasibility check and ahead of the EU recognition process. Tesla Europe said rollout begins soon, with no date. Tesla listing is not independently confirmed. That is the twelfth EU country. Recognition is not a TCMV vote.

item.title: Update, 11 Nov 2026
item.description: Finland’s Traficom recognised the Dutch provisional type-approval on 10 Nov 2026 (notice published 11 Nov). Tesla Assisted Driving may be used on Finnish roads. Tesla listing is not independently confirmed. That is the eleventh EU country. Recognition is not a TCMV vote.

item.title: Update, 10 Nov 2026
item.description: Re-checked Teslascope and the Europe atlas. 2026.38.5.12 is now the largest Teslascope v14.3.13 sample. A Netherlands owner posted 2026.39.100 as Tesla Assisted Driving v14.2.2.7 with the RDW +10% speed cap; Teslascope has not recorded that build. No new EU country recognition. Tesla manufacturer pages remain 403, so Latvia is not independently re-listed.

item.title: Update, 28 Oct 2026
item.description: Latvia's 26 Oct recognition of the Dutch RDW approval is now recorded from the Latvian Ministry of Transport / CSDD notice, the tenth EU country. Tesla has not listed customer availability there yet; rollout begins soon.

item.title: Update, 28 Oct 2026
item.description: Added a 'When it updates next' table, a follow-by-email box, an RSS feed of this change log, a share image and a country picker in the markets section.

item.title: Update, 28 Oct 2026
item.description: Added the safety claims section (Tesla's published crash-rate comparisons, with what each is compared against) and the promises strip (all 15 FSD / autonomy entries in the ledger), which reads the same ledger as the promise tracker.

item.title: Update, 28 Oct 2026
item.description: Added the world map of Tesla-listed markets, the EU state tiles, the two FSD·EU thresholds (reported by FSD·EU, not an EU announcement), the recognition timeline and the population share, which is our own arithmetic on Eurostat's 1 January 2025 figures.

item.title: Update, 28 Oct 2026
item.description: Added the cumulative FSD miles chart (read from Tesla's deck chart, marked approximate), the Teslascope build charts (running totals of cars seen on each build, and new cars per day) and the FSD release timeline.

item.title: Update, 27 Oct 2026
item.description: Page created. Adoption figures are taken from Tesla's Q1, Q2 and Q3 2026 shareholder decks; countries come from our global FSD tracker data.
